meaning.en: Something that happened to you or that you learned by doing.
meaning.taglish: Nangyari sa iyo o natutunan mo sa paggawa.
meaning.fil: Isang nangyari sa iyo o natutunan mo sa paggawa.

examples.work: My first job was a valuable experience.
examples.everyday: Learning to swim was a new experience for me.

options: An event that has not yet occurred.
Something that happened to you or that you learned by doing.
check.explanation: Experience: Something that happened to you or that you learned by doing. Example: My first job was a valuable experience.
check.hint: Notice the meaning in this example: My first job was a valuable experience.

explanation.en: An experience is a real event or learning opportunity.
explanation.taglish: Ang experience ay karanasan o kaalamang nakuha mo sa paggawa.
explanation.fil: Isang nangyari sa iyo o natutunan mo sa paggawa.

meaning.fil: Pagkukuwento ng isang pangyayari sa nakaraan.

examples.work: I remember when I first started working.
examples.everyday: I remember when we first visited that place.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.text: Was it hard to learn your first job?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I remember when I first started working.

check.prompt: Complete: 'I remember when I ___ my first job.'
check.explanation: The first job began in the past, so use 'started': I remember when I started my first job.
check.hint: Read the example: I remember when I first started working.

grammarTip.explanation: Use a past-tense verb for a finished event: 'I started my first job.' Some verbs change differently: 'go' becomes 'went'. 'I remember when...' introduces the memory.

speaking.scenario: Tell a story about a time you learned something new.
hints: I remember when I had to learn a new skill.
Ask a follow-up question or end politely.
speaking.oneMinuteGoal: Introduce your point and support it with one example.
speaking.twoMinuteGoal: Add a second example, a reason, and a friendly closing.
speaking.modelResponse: I remember when I started my first job. I was nervous because everything was new, but my coworkers helped me learn. That experience taught me to ask questions when I need help.
selfReview: I answered the situation with a clear main message.
I included the detail or question the listener needs.
I chose one sentence to improve or practice again.

durationGuidance.en: One and two minutes are optional practice targets, not minimums. A shorter complete message counts. Start with two or three sentences, then add detail if useful.
durationGuidance.taglish: Optional targets lang ang isa o dalawang minuto. Puwedeng mas maikli basta malinaw ang mensahe. Magsimula sa dalawa o tatlong pangungusap.
durationGuidance.fil: Gabay lamang ang isa o dalawang minuto, hindi kailangang abutin. Sapat ang mas maikling sagot kung malinaw ang mensahe.

speaking.modelResponseNote: This is one short example, not a script to memorize or a timed one-minute answer. Your details and wording may differ.

prompt.en: Before speaking, try to recall a useful expression from Day 10. Use it if it fits today's situation; no extra recording is needed.
prompt.taglish: Bago magsalita, subukang alalahanin ang isang expression sa Day 10. Gamitin kung bagay sa situation today; hindi kailangan ng dagdag na recording.
prompt.fil: Bago magsalita, alalahanin ang isang pahayag mula sa Araw 10. Gamitin kung angkop; hindi kailangan ng dagdag na rekording.
